verdict.rationale: Square supports OAuth with per-permission scopes for granular access control, and its remote MCP server explicitly uses OAuth login to 'authorize only the scopes your application needs' for agent connections; the local MCP server also supports a DISALLOW_WRITES read-only mode and SANDBOX flag for least-privilege agent setups. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of scope granularity in practice, and no explicit documentation of fine-grained scope lists specifically tailored for agent use cases beyond general OAuth scopes.
